title: Feedback
description:
* [x] Use `grepl("^macOS", utils::osVersion)` for single platform check. Apply for all other platforms. Bluntly say to use your local platform (even if it's hosted by Linux)
* [x] Delete `master` branch
* [x] Rename branches to `minimal`, `single_platform_snapshot`, `multi_platform_snapshot`
* [x] Add a template repo for people to use (Use the Single platform snapshot setup).
* [x] Talk about how to download artifacts
* [x] Talk about creating branches instead of artifacts. (Brief mention in multiplatform setup). (Point to shinycoreci-apps workflow file for creating branches. Helpful when sensitive to R version and Platform.)
* [x] Move `shinytest` text block up above GitHub Actions block
* [x] Add whether to clone or call particular functions
